$\blueD{62\%}$ $\greenD{\text{of}}$ $\maroonD{45}$ is the same as $\blueD{62\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{45}$.

To solve $\blueD{62\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{45}$, we need to convert $\blueD{62\%}$ to either a decimal or a fraction.

Percent means per hundred, so $\blueD{62\%}$ is equivalent to $\blueD{\dfrac{62}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\blueD{62\div 100=0.62}$.

 $\blueD{62\%= \dfrac{62}{100} = 0.62}$

$\begin{align}\blueD{62\%}\ \text{of}\ \maroonD{45}&=\blueD{\dfrac{62}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{45}\\\\
&=\blueD{0.62}\cdot\maroonD{45}\\\\
&=27.9
\end{align}$

Are any of the other choices equivalent?

$45\div 0.62\approx 72.6$

The expression $45\div 0.62$ is **not** equivalent to $62\%$ of $45$.

$62\div 45\approx 1.38$

The expression $62\div 45$ is **not** equivalent to $62\%$ of $45$.

$62\cdot 45=2{,}790$

The expression $62\cdot 45$ is **not** equivalent to $62\%$ of $45$.

The options that have the same value as $62\%$ of $45$ are:

- $\dfrac{62}{100}\cdot 45$
- $0.62\cdot 45$

choices.clue: We should multiply instead of divide by $0.62$.
This choice is $\dfrac{4}{81}$ times as large as $62\%$ of $45$.
This choice is $100$ times as large as $62\%$ of $45$.
